tool.description: Decompress a gzip (.gz) file or blob back to its original bytes, returned as a downloadable file. The original filename is recovered from the gzip header when present (otherwise the .gz suffix is stripped). Provide the file as either url (HTTP/HTTPS) or ref (id from a prior tool call). For .tar.gz archives use extract-tar instead.

url.description: File URL (HTTP/HTTPS). Use either url or ref.

ref.description: Reference id from a prior tool call. Use either url or ref.
